9-Day Complete Jordan Tour: Petra, Desert & Dead Sea
summary:
The 9-Day Jordan Tour Package traces a route from northern Jordan to the desert landscapes of the south, with the Dead Sea completing the journey. Begin in Amman and explore the Roman city of Jerash before visiting Madaba and Mount Nebo. Continue to Petra for its Nabataean monuments, then exchange conventional hotel accommodation for a night in a Wadi Rum desert camp. Time at the Dead Sea brings a slower pace before the trip ends.
Year-round departures are possible, with selected 4-star hotels, one desert-camp night, breakfast, English-speaking local guides, private transportation, transfers and scheduled sightseeing arranged throughout the route.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Queen Alia International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Amman.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Jerash – Anjara – Umm Qais
itinerary.text:
08:00am Depart from Amman and travel to the ancient city of Jerash, home to one of the best-preserved Roman archaeological sites in the world. Explore its magnificent Oval Plaza, Temple of Artemis, Hadrian's Arch, colonnaded streets, theaters, and other impressive Roman monuments.
Continue to Anjara to visit the Shrine of Our Lady of the Mountain, an important Christian pilgrimage site believed to have been visited by Jesus, the Virgin Mary, and the disciples during their travels through the region.
Afterwards, drive to Umm Qais (ancient Gadara), where you can admire spectacular panoramic views overlooking the Sea of Galilee, the Jordan Valley, and the Golan Heights while exploring the remains of this historic Greco-Roman city.
Following the tour, return to Amman and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Bethany – Mt. Nebo – Madaba
itinerary.text:
08:30am Depart for Bethany Beyond the Jordan, the revered site where Jesus Christ is believed to have been baptized by John the Baptist. Explore this important pilgrimage destination before continuing to Mount Nebo, where Moses is said to have viewed the Promised Land. Enjoy spectacular panoramic views over the Jordan Valley, the Dead Sea, and, on clear days, even Jerusalem.
Continue to Madaba, the "City of Mosaics," renowned for its remarkable Byzantine and Umayyad mosaics. Visit the historic Saint George's Church, home to the famous 6th-century Mosaic Map of the Holy Land, one of the oldest surviving maps of the region.
After the tour, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Madaba.

itinerary.title: Mukawir – Kerak – Petra
itinerary.text:
08:00am Depart from Amman and travel to Mukawir (Machaerus), the ancient hilltop fortress best known as the place where John the Baptist was imprisoned and executed. Enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea before continuing your journey.
Drive along the historic King's Highway, one of the world's oldest trade routes, passing through the ancient lands of Edom and Moab. Arrive at Kerak Castle, one of the largest and best-preserved Crusader fortresses in the Middle East, and explore its impressive halls, tunnels, and defensive walls.
After the visit, continue to Petra and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra Visit
itinerary.text:
08:00am Begin your exploration of Petra, the legendary Rose-Red City and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. Enter the ancient city through the narrow Siq, a dramatic sandstone gorge leading to the breathtaking Al-Khazneh (The Treasury).
Continue your visit to the Street of Facades, the Royal Tombs, and Qasr Al-Bint, discovering the remarkable architecture and rich history of the Nabataean civilization. Those wishing to extend their adventure may choose to climb the steps to Ad Deir (The Monastery), where spectacular panoramic views await.
After the tour, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum Desert
itinerary.text:
08:30am Depart for Wadi Rum, Jordan's spectacular desert wilderness, renowned for its towering sandstone mountains, vast red sand dunes, dramatic canyons, and breathtaking scenery.
Upon arrival, enjoy a 2-hour 4×4 Jeep safari led by a local Bedouin driver, exploring the desert's unique rock formations, natural arches, ancient Nabataean inscriptions, and panoramic viewpoints that have made Wadi Rum one of the world's most iconic landscapes.
In the evening, check in to your traditional Bedouin desert camp, where you will enjoy dinner under the stars before an unforgettable overnight stay in the heart of Wadi Rum.

itinerary.title: Lot’s Cave – Dead Sea – Amman
itinerary.text:
08:30am Depart from Wadi Rum and drive towards the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth. En route, visit Lot's Cave, a historic site traditionally associated with the story of Prophet Lot, offering impressive views over the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea.
Continue to the Dead Sea, where you will have free time to relax, float effortlessly in its mineral-rich waters, or enjoy the therapeutic mud renowned for its natural healing properties.
Later in the afternoon, drive to Amman and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Amman City Tour
itinerary.text:
09:00am Discover Amman, Jordan's vibrant capital, known in biblical times as Rabbath-Ammon. Begin your sightseeing at the Amman Citadel, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the city while exploring its ancient ruins. Continue to the Jordan Archaeological Museum and the Jordan Folklore Museum to learn about the country's rich history and cultural heritage.
Next, visit the impressive Roman Theater, one of the best-preserved Roman monuments in the Middle East, followed by a visit to a local Coptic Church.
After the tour, enjoy the remainder of the day at leisure to explore Amman's cafés, shops, and local markets at your own pace. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Departure from Amman
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Transfer to Queen Alia International Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 9-Day Tour of Jordan?
faqs.a: The 9-Day Tour of Jordan covers Amman, Jerash, Madaba, Mount Nebo, Kerak, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea. This private itinerary combines Jordan's ancient cities, biblical landmarks, crusader castles, desert landscapes, and natural wonders, offering a comprehensive exploration of the country. The tour runs for 8 nights and 9 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 9-Day Tour of Jordan cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,395 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, an English-speaking driver, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and airport and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire journey. You will travel in a comfortable private vehicle with an English-speaking driver, providing flexibility and convenience during your trip across Jordan.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near the destinations included in the itinerary.

faqs.q: Is a guide included in the tour?
faqs.a: This package includes an English-speaking driver rather than a full-time tour guide. Local guides can be arranged at major attractions such as Petra upon request. Your driver will assist with transportation, logistics, and general information throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who prefer the comfort and flexibility of a private journey. It covers Jordan's most famous attractions while allowing travelers to explore at their own pace.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, desert landscapes, and historic landmarks. Petra requires significant walking, and some sites feature uneven terrain and stairs.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Petra, Wadi Rum, Mount Nebo, and the Dead Sea?
faqs.a: Petra is Jordan's most famous UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its rock-carved monuments and the Treasury. Wadi Rum offers dramatic desert scenery and jeep safari adventures. Mount Nebo is believed to be the place where Moses viewed the Promised Land. The Dead Sea is famous for its mineral-rich waters and the unique ability to float effortlessly on its surface.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 9-Day Tour of Jordan?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 9-Day Tour of Jordan be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be fully customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include local guides, add Aqaba or additional desert experiences, or modify the itinerary to suit your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
